abstract: This paper asks whether macroeconomic policy can affect fertility and education by documenting a slow-down of long-term improvements in these two outcomes in the wake of a major protectionist shock that shielded low-skilled individuals from the adverse consequences of the first wave of globalisation. We build a novel dataset for 19th-century France where, following decades of rising grain imports at low prices, high tariffs on cereal were introduced in 1892, shifting relative prices in favour of agriculture and away from industry. We exploit regional data that allow us to measure differences in the intensity of the protectionist shock and find that the tariff halted the long-term increase in schooling and slowed-down the decline in fertility that were already well underway.
abstract_zh: 本文通过记录一次重大保护主义冲击后生育率与教育水平长期改善进程的放缓，探讨宏观经济政策能否影响这两项指标。该保护主义政策使低技能劳动者免受第一波全球化浪潮的不利影响。我们构建了19世纪法国的新数据集：在经历数十年低价谷物进口增长后，1892年对谷物征收高额关税，导致相对价格向农业倾斜而偏离工业。通过利用可衡量保护主义冲击强度的区域数据，我们发现该关税政策终止了已持续多年的教育普及化进程，并减缓了生育率的下降趋势。
title: The toll of tariffs: The impact of protectionism on education and fertility in late 19th century France
title_zh: 关税的代价：19世纪末法国保护主义对教育与生育率的影响

abstract: This paper uses a multi-recipient dictator game to examine whether in-group favoritism increases donations to in-group institutions but decreases donations to out-group institutions. By comparing individual donations to in-group institutions, out-group institutions, and total donations in different treatments, I find that the total donations are similar in different treatments, but the donations each institution receives are different. Individuals donate equally when they encounter two out-group institutions, but, they tend to donate a larger amount to the in-group institution and a smaller amount to the out-group institution. These results demonstrate that donations to the in-group institution due to the effect of in-group favoritism increase at the expense of donations to the out-group institution.
abstract_zh: 本文采用多接受者独裁者博弈实验，考察内群体偏袒是否会增加对内群体机构的捐赠，同时减少对外群体机构的捐赠。通过比较不同实验处理中个体对内群体机构、外群体机构及总捐赠额的差异，本研究发现：不同处理下的总捐赠额相近，但各机构获得的捐赠额存在差异。当个体面对两个外群体机构时，其捐赠行为呈现均等化特征；然而，当面对内群体机构与外群体机构时，个体倾向于向内群体机构捐赠更多金额，而向外群体机构捐赠更少金额。这些结果表明，内群体偏袒效应导致对内群体机构的捐赠增加，是以牺牲对外群体机构的捐赠为代价的。
title: How in-group favoritism affects individual donation decisions: A laboratory experimental study
title_zh: 内群体偏爱如何影响个人捐赠决策：一项实验室实验研究

abstract: ABSTRACT Crop choices affect soil organic carbon (SOC) stocks, allowing farmers to manipulate the amount of carbon sequestered in the soil over time. This paper examines the private and public benefits of crop rotations that sequester additional carbon across the province of Saskatchewan, Canada using a novel field‐level dataset from the Saskatchewan Crop Insurance Corporation matched with data on weather, soil and simulated SOC. I begin by estimating the on‐farm shadow value of SOC using a dynamic panel regression model and find that it is positive with diminishing marginal returns; the yield (and thus profit) response to SOC is larger in soil zones with less SOC and smaller in soil zones with more SOC. I then use dynamic simulations to estimate the SOC and yield response to different crop rotations over time. The adoption of the Canola‐Spring Wheat‐Peas‐Spring Wheat crop rotation leads to a 27.5%, 8.2% and 4.4% increase in long‐term average profit compared to current levels in the brown, dark brown and black & grey soil zones attributable to increased SOC over 32 years of average weather conditions. Finally, I compute the external social benefit from the Canola‐Spring Wheat‐Peas‐Spring Wheat rotation relative to Spring Wheat‐Fallow‐Spring Wheat‐Fallow on all insurable hectares in Saskatchewan from 2023 to 2055, and find benefits amounting to 108 billion CAD when employing a social cost of carbon of 185 USD/Mg of CO 2 . These results show that selecting crop rotations that have greater SOC sequestration potential not only improves on‐farm profitability over time, but can generate substantial environmental benefits.
abstract_zh: 摘要 作物选择影响土壤有机碳（SOC）储量，使农民能够随时间推移调控土壤中固存的碳量。本文利用来自萨斯喀彻温省作物保险公司的田间级新数据集，结合天气、土壤及模拟SOC数据，考察了加拿大萨斯喀彻温省境内能够额外固碳的作物轮作所带来的私人及公共效益。首先，我采用动态面板回归模型估算SOC的农场内影子价值，发现其为正且边际回报递减；在SOC含量较低的土壤区域，产量（进而利润）对SOC的响应较大，而在SOC含量较高的土壤区域，响应较小。随后，我运用动态模拟评估不同作物轮作随时间对SOC和产量的影响。在平均天气条件下持续32年，采用油菜-春小麦-豌豆-春小麦轮作相较于当前水平，在棕色、深棕色及黑灰色土壤区域，因SOC增加导致长期平均利润分别提高27.5%、8.2%和4.4%。最后，我计算了2023年至2055年间，在萨斯喀彻温省所有可投保公顷土地上，油菜-春小麦-豌豆-春小麦轮作相对于春小麦-休耕-春小麦-休耕轮作所产生的外部社会效益，发现采用185美元/吨二氧化碳的社会碳成本时，效益总额达1080亿加元。这些结果表明，选择具有更高SOC固存潜力的作物轮作不仅能随时间提升农场盈利能力，还能产生显著的环境效益。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: The Consequences of Soil Organic Carbon for Crop Yield, Farm Productivity and Profit
title_zh: 土壤有机碳对作物产量、农场生产力及利润的影响
